remarks: HIGHEST & BEST DUE MONDAY 1/13 BY 5PM. Nestled in the highly desirable neighborhood of Cos Cob, this meticulously maintained home features a perfect blend of timeless charm and modern comfort. Gleaming hardwood floors flow throughout, enhancing its warm and inviting atmosphere. The chef's kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a spacious center island, and ample room for gathering. Upstairs, the primary suite is a tranquil retreat with a luxurious bathroom and a spacious walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms and another full bathroom complete the second level. The partially finished basement adds versatility with a additional room, full bathroom, and laundry/exercise area. Outdoors, enjoy a backyard oasis, fully renovated in 2021 with a lush lawn, sprinkler system, vinyl fencing, and Trex decking on both porches. Entertain on the Italian porcelain tile patio or around the custom firepit. The detached two-car garage features a screened in garage door and provides ample storage and flexibility, ideal for vehicles, hobbies, or a workshop.
